slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did God become Shem’s descendant? Noah calls the LORD “the God of Shem.” Luke later lists Shem among Jesus’s ancestors. Some Christians combine these facts into a prediction that God would join Shem’s family.
slides.body: Noah calls the LORD “the God of Shem.” Luke later lists Shem among Jesus’s ancestors. Some Christians combine these facts into a prediction that God would join Shem’s family.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Shem’s family line leads to Abraham, Israel and eventually Jesus. The next verse may also picture God living among Shem’s people. For Christians who believe Jesus is God, those details can feel significant.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But that isn’t what Noah says Noah says the LORD is Shem’s God. He never says God will be born as one of Shem’s descendants. Luke supplies Jesus’s family tree, but does not say Noah predicted it.
